name: system-prompt
description: Appends your own instructions to Claude's system context at the start of every session, configured from Claude Code settings.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Inject the configured content. Turn off to keep the settings but stop injecting.

prompt.title: Prompt text
prompt.description: Text appended to Claude's system context. Write \n for a line break.

prompt_file.title: Prompt file
prompt_file.description: Path to a file whose contents are appended after the prompt text. ~ expands to your home; relative paths resolve against the project directory. Several paths can be separated with commas.

every_prompt.title: Repeat on every prompt
every_prompt.description: Also re-inject the content with each message you send, for stronger adherence in long sessions. Costs tokens on every turn.
